## Rules

- For every stage: `max single call + persistence/release reserve <= remaining job budget`, `job timeout < supervisor timeout < retry_after`, lease covers intended active slice and is released/recovered, shutdown grace is not shorter than graceful completion/checkpoint path. OCR must either get a compatible lane or bounded child/checkpoint behavior. Effective production config is captured, not inferred from test defaults. RAG:✅ 2026-09-10 — Laravel Horizon rule cited in audit/acceptance.

## Guidance

Extend `QueueTimeoutInvariantTest` with the maximum next-call reserve and every connection/supervisor mapping. Real-worker contract launches actual Redis/Horizon jobs with controllable slow doubles, observes PID/job state, sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL in separate cases, and reconciles output/state before verdict. Assert no two workers hold the same analysis/job lease. Do not sleep for production-length time in PHPUnit; use small test-profile budgets with identical inequalities. Preserve unrelated dirty compose/config hunks surgically.
